transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the importance of performance efficiency in the ATM system. EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed within 3 seconds for user satisfaction. EFF-02 guarantees a throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, crucial for high-demand environments. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval to minimize latency, enhancing user experience. EFF-04 aligns with SAF-01 and TRU-04 to prevent negative balances efficiently. EFF-05 ensures automatic fund withdrawal without user delay, improving responsiveness. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on insufficient funds, enhancing user interaction. EFF-07 promotes load balancing to manage requests effectively, ensuring system stability.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-01 aims to minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing, which is crucial for reducing the environmental impact. GRN-02 provides a carbon footprint report for each transaction, promoting transparency and accountability. GRN-03 ensures the use of energy-efficient hardware, while GRN-04 focuses on minimizing data storage requirements to reduce resource usage. GRN-05 offers clients electronic transaction records, reducing paper waste. GRN-06 promotes energy savings by shutting down during inactivity, and GRN-07 ensures annual assessments of environmental impact. These requirements align with modern sustainability goals and should be prioritized.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance and shall prevent overdrafts.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when sufficient funds are available.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide immediate feedback while notifying users of insufficient funds.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds while optimizing for energy efficiency.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The ATM system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
